With that in mind
Travelers: bring your pet papers early and keep them easy to show at the desk.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Please check that your companion animal has the right travel papers before you leave for the airport. Our staff will review the basics, help you sort out missing details, and point out anything that could slow the trip. <<FACT F082>> Keep your carrier clean, secure, and sized for your animal, and make sure food, water, and comfort items are packed for the journey.

If you are traveling with a rabbit, or with any other companion animal, use calm handling and allow extra room for check-in steps. The senior coordinator oversees day-to-day service choices, and trained staff give each animal patient attention so the process stays steady and clear. If you need help, come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding and we will guide you from there.
